sentence: This project holds a conference on how data collected over time can be used to make faster decisions in healthcare and security.
This project builds a test that uses bacteriophage mixtures to identify the bacteria in blood infections and find which antibiotics should work.
This project uses quantum calculations and artificial intelligence to search for van der Waals materials with desirable spin and topological properties.
This project builds statistical models to link brain activity to behavior in freely moving animals.
This project uses deep learning to discover the equations that govern traffic and to study how connected and automated vehicles behave.
This project studies how models of many particles connect to fluid models of gas dynamics.
This project builds methods that use artificial intelligence to identify mosquito species from high resolution images.
This project uses age-dating methods on sedimentary deposits to work out how a lake and the landscape around it changed through time.
This project builds machine learning tools that study large amounts of nanomaterial data to predict properties and help design nanomaterials.
This project removes plants that live on other plants in a tropical cloud forest to see how trees, microclimate and water cycling change.
This project builds microenvironments around single stem cells to study how they guide cell growth and division.
This project builds a defense that helps connected autonomous vehicles resist attacks that mislead their machine learning.
This project uses machine learning to speed up ocean data assimilation and to say how uncertain the results are.
This project builds defenses that protect metaverse and virtual reality users from adversarial attacks and loss of privacy.
This project holds a conference that brings together researchers from many parts of combinatorics to share common techniques.
This project studies how Arctic cities can use their biocultural heritage, including language and traditional ecological knowledge, to adapt to climate change.
This project studies how the structure and function of RNA governs cellular processes.
This project builds open-source machine learning models and tools and applies them to research problems.
This project builds statistical methods to link differences in traits among species to their evolutionary history.
